newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean fishing boat said seized by China.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean fishing boat said seized by China.

text.p: China has seized a South Korean trawler and detained all 11 crew members on board, an officer at the maritime police said on Saturday.

The officer in the western port city of Inchon said the 69-tonne boat sent a radio message that it had been seized. It was fishing for crabs 200 miles (320 kms) south of South Korea's southern Cheju Island.
"We are not sure why they were captured," he said. "But we received a radio message from the fishing boat that it had not entered waters controlled by China."
He said the Chinese were questioning the fishermen.
